decisions.decision: primary strategy is an offscreen export viewport whose geometry and coordinates represent the ExportArea at output resolution: exact rectangle, zero outside padding, complete content even partly or wholly outside the visible viewport, appropriate recomputation and rendering of points, functions, axes, grid, labels, legacy loci and LocusV2 for the export viewport, SVG based on the export area; no silent substitution by distributed per-drawable modifications; if the viewport is not viable without a material widening of the shared renderer or of the verification class, B stops and requests escalation

precedence explicitly activated producer > Export_1/Export_2 > visible viewport; upstream selectionRectangle is never ExportArea authority and never silently displaces Export_1/Export_2; ExportArea is SESSION: not serialized, not part of undo, reset on New/Open, after which Export_1/Export_2 act again automatically when both valid points exist; producers implemented in B: EXPORT_POINTS and MANUAL; ISO_A_SELECTION and ISO_A_BORDER in E3

surface: Graphics View as Picture (PNG, PDF, SVG, EMF/EMF+), DXF, PSTricks, PGF/TikZ, Asymptote, Print Preview; not exposed: STL, Collada, HTML Collada, Dynamic Worksheet / worksheet upload, Animated GIF; Ctrl+Shift+U -> GeoCeDG Picture surface; Ctrl+Shift+C -> the same Picture surface / graphics-clipboard service, no second direct route with its own authority; Ctrl+Shift+W consumed, no Worksheet; Ctrl+Shift+M consumed, no HTML5 export; Ctrl+Shift+D -> GeoCeDG DXF only, upstream double effect removed; Ctrl+Shift+B kept (Base64 document copy, not a graphics export); the v1 fallback also filters STL, Collada, HTML Collada and Worksheet; a fallback mode reopening an expressly excluded surface is not accepted
Print Preview stays and obeys ExportArea; the graphics clipboard stays as a consumer of the same Picture/export service and ExportArea, not a second mechanism; Animated GIF is out of this generation
--export stays supported and uses the same export service and ExportArea; --exportAnimation is rejected explicitly while Animated GIF stays out; no command-line route with a different area authority
GGBScript ExportImage and the relevant graphics APIs obey the same ExportArea authority; ExportImage becomes a GeoCeDG-modified command and enters the GGBScript compatibility matrix and its tests
ISO_A_SELECTION and ISO_A_BORDER are not implemented in B; they are delivered in E3 after the D1 unit contract
